## What's changed

- Added alternate audio-track discovery and selection for Tater Tube Player playback sessions.
- Preferred the best compatible English, non-commentary audio track so an available surround track stays direct instead of being needlessly reduced to stereo AAC.
- Applied the selected audio track consistently to direct, audio-only, video-only, and full-transcode playback paths.
- Kept these additions isolated to the modern player playback-session API so existing Tater Tube clients retain their current playback behavior.
